scene_description: A candid, documentary-style photograph illustrating careful inventory and high-value asset protection. Inside a well-lit living room, two Black South African movers in unbranded black one-piece work overalls are handling a heavy, highly valuable antique grandfather clock. The clock is already meticulously swathed in thick, professional-grade grey moving blankets and tightly bound in clear shrink wrap (with brown packing tape strictly applied only to the plastic layers). One mover, with a light sweat sheen, is carefully stabilizing the item, while the second mover stands next to him holding a rugged digital tablet, focused on logging the high-value item into the digital inventory manifest before it moves to the truck. The scene emphasizes accountability, real numbers, and the 'safety net' of proper documentation. Warm natural light filters through the windows, highlighting the textures of the moving materials. The image features a realistic film grain and zero branding.
visual_details: Two movers in unbranded black overalls, carefully handling a highly wrapped valuable antique, thick blankets and shrink wrap (tape strictly on plastic), one mover logging inventory on a rugged tablet, accountability/insurance focus, warm natural interior light, candid documentary photography, film grain, zero logos or text.
camera_settings: Shot on Kodak Portra 400, 35mm lens, f/4.0, 1/125 sec, ISO 400. Focused on the worker with the tablet and the wrapped antique, soft natural daylight.

scene_description: An early morning documentary-style photograph taken outside a clean, modern light industrial warehouse unit in Alberton, South Africa. In the foreground, an older, experienced White man (representing the hands-on owner) dressed in a plain, unbranded dark blue polo shirt and work trousers is conducting a focused, serious pre-move briefing with two Black South African movers. The movers are dressed in their professional, unbranded black one-piece work overalls and are listening attentively. Behind them is the open tailgate of an unmarked white moving truck and a neat stack of pristine, clean corrugated cardboard boxes and fresh rolls of bubble wrap. The image conveys an owner-led operation, trained professional crews, and a secure, organized operational base. The cool, angular morning light casts long shadows. Raw, authentic film texture with no corporate branding visible anywhere.
visual_details: Hands-on owner briefing two professional movers, Alberton light industrial warehouse background, unbranded black overalls on movers, plain clothing on owner, stack of clean/fresh packing materials, unmarked moving truck, early morning light, serious professional interaction, documentary style, film grain, zero branding.
camera_settings: Shot on Fujifilm Pro 400H, 50mm lens, f/5.6, 1/200 sec, ISO 200. Crisp morning light, sharp focus on the group interaction, realistic depth of field.
